result.title: PersonaScienceBench: Evaluating Scientific Agents with Diverse Simulated Researchers
result.summary: Scientific agents collaborate with researchers whose expertise and preferences differ, but benchmarks usually hold the collaborator fixed. We introduce PersonaScienceBench: 200 tasks from five benchmarks across four scientific domains. Simulated researchers provide context and feedback according to persona profiles, while task objectives and grading remain fixed. Agents encounter researcher preferences only through conversation. Across eighteen modelconfigurations, task performance, fact recovery, and self-repetition reveal different strengths. Detailed GPT 6 Astra analyses show distinct agent responses across researcher profiles; interaction traces illustrate targeted clar ification and workflow revision. These behaviors can differ even when final scores match. PersonaScienceBench therefore evaluates how agents collaborate with diverse researchers alongside whether they complete the task.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 PersonaScienceBench，用 200 个跨四领域任务和带不同画像的模拟研究者，考察科学智能体在仅通过对话获知合作者偏好的情况下完成任务、恢复事实与调整工作流的表现。
